notes: Integration notes for R0. (1) Merge first in M1 as planned. scripts/postbuild.ts already calls writeHeaders() after prerenderPages(), so when WP-10 inlines the real boot script and prerenders /exhibit/<id>/, /resume/ and /404.html, the hash and the inline-script rules cover every page with no WP-06 change. writeHeaders fails the build on a second inline script in a page, on pages with different inline scripts, and on any on*= attribute; it does not check that /resume/ and /404.html omit the boot script (ARCHITECTURE §5.3 leaves that to WP-10). (2) WP-07's playwright.config.ts can use 'npx tsx scripts/serve-dist.ts --port <PORT>' as specified. serve-dist re-reads dist/_headers on every request, so reuseExistingServer is safe across rebuilds. Beyond §12.2 it accepts --dir <folder> (tests), answers 405 to methods other than GET and HEAD, never serves /_headers or /_redirects (Netlify does not), and joins a header name set by two matching rules with ', ' as Netlify merges it. A /x/* rule matches /x/ and below but not the bare /x, so /resume without the slash gets the /* headers and no Cache-Control locally. (3) check-budgets finds debug-only code by manifest chunk names and by six string fingerprints (leva: leva__root, __levaInput; r3f-perf: muiPerf, __perf_toggle; leva's zustand 3: 'ServerSideRendering|^Deno' and its subscribeWithSelector deprecation text). All six survive minification in a scratch Vite build that imports leva and r3f-perf; none appears in any other node_modules package or in the current entry chunk. Exhibit rows count each src/museum/exhibits/<id>/ dynamic entry plus the static imports no other exhibit, the entry or the museum chunk uses; the ?debug chunk is reported, never budgeted. (4) check-copy scans 'git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard' (tracked plus new, non-ignored files, so a new file is checked before its first commit) and, with --dist, every dist/ text file plus the unpdf text of dist/resume.pdf. Content hits print as content.<path>, with array items labelled by id (for example content.experiences[verafin].exhibit). (5) Lighthouse, local and advisory: CHROME_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium npm run lh collected 3 mobile runs of /?test=1&mode=museum (performance 1, accessibility 0.91, best-practices 0.96, seo 0.9, LCP about 1.3 s, CLS 0), then stopped with exit 1 because /exhibit/verafin/ is a 404 until WP-10 prerenders it, so the desktop config never started. A one-run desktop collect of / confirmed formFactor desktop and the assertion matrix (accessibility 0.91 and seo 0.9 fail the 0.95 error gates on the WP-01 placeholder hero). The CI job is continue-on-error until WP-29. Desktop reports go to .lighthouseci/desktop/ so the mobile reports in .lighthouseci/ survive the second autorun (lhci collect clears only the top-level lhr-* files); the CI artifact uploads all of .lighthouseci/. (6) e2e, a11y and visual are still WP-07 stubs, so the e2e job passes trivially until WP-07 merges; a dispatch with update-baselines before any @visual spec exists fails with Playwright's 'No tests found'. (7) Dependabot reads .github/dependabot.yml from the default branch only, so it stays inactive until the launch merge to main. (8) Removed @fontsource/source-serif-4 5.3.1 (WP-04 chose CMU Serif from computer-modern): package.json and package-lock.json lose only that entry; npm ci from the new lockfile is clean and npm ls --depth=0 shows only the allowed sharp optional extraneous packages. (9) No dependency requests; nothing pushed; no tags.
